criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 20 May 2028 (24 months after the 20 May 2026 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($425,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $620,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $84,380,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $83,760,000 is wrong.
Calculates the long-stop date as 28 July 2026 (150 days after signing on 28 February 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 11 August 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Shows the adjustment arithmetic ($85,000,000 - $620,000 = $84,380,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (24 months) and as a date (20 May 2028), with days remaining from 25 March 2026 (787 days).
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
